how_to_edit: rookies: name, position (QB/RB/WR/TE/K), team (schedule code, e.g. MIA, LA, LV, WAS), pick (projected overall pick, 1-262), college, optional hype (1-3: a prospect rated beyond his pick; market premium and expected role x hype). moves: name (as the app spells him), position, team (new team code, or null = retired / out of the league), note. One object per line; names must be unique across both lists.
rookie_method: Round 1-3 landing spots follow the newest mock with the player (Stick to the Model 2026-11-23, then PFN Cummings 7-round 2026-11-21, PFN Sheath 2026-11-15, FanSided/Yahoo top 10 2026-11-22); a QB a team already took moves to his next-newest mock's team. Ranked prospects no mock places are day-3 picks assigned by team need (listed in rookie_notes).
rookie_notes: Jeremiah Smith: every current mock has him No. 1 overall to Tennessee (Miami picks 3rd in them, taking a QB); he is placed on Miami at No. 1 as the user expects. hype 1.3: his market premium and expected role x1.3, set so his ADP lands at Marvin Harrison Jr.'s rookie ADP (14.5, 2024 PPR); across 20 seeds he finished top-12 30%, top-24 55%, outside the top 36 25%.
Arch Manning: Arizona at 6 (FanSided/Yahoo, PFN Sheath); PFN Cummings has him returning to Texas for 2027.
Darian Mensah: Pittsburgh at 23 (PFN Cummings has Pittsburgh taking a QB at 23, Sheath at 26); Stick to the Model had him to the Jets at 6, who take Mestemaker here.
CJ Carr: Chargers at 33 per Stick to the Model (newest); other mocks have him in the top 20 (Miami 3, Jets 4, Cleveland 16).
Justice Haynes, Mark Fletcher Jr., Terrance Carter Jr., Adam Mohammed: ranked prospects with no mock landing spot; day-3 picks assigned by team need.
